thesis: Discord is the screen, identity, ACL, notification, and object plane. This process on one Mac is the computer. AWS names are analogs, not a second cloud.
constraints: REST default; Gateway only for On/Off buttons
Artifacts are Discord objects (channel/message/attachment/sha256); never persist a CDN URL as the key
Two Discord threads cook at once; implement writes serialize per realm cwd
One live card per job; edit in place; do not flood the thread
Host tools are CLI or HTTP; no MCP bus inside Discord
No hosted fleet; no isolated VMs; JSON never YAML; no emojis

analogs.discord: guild roles + pair owner/operator allowlist
analogs.note: Discord roles are the ACL chrome. Pairing is the actual who-may-dispatch gate after first On.

analogs.discord: pairing tickets + KeyVault HMAC session
analogs.note: Tickets are assume-role for keys, not Discord OAuth for every job.

analogs.discord: this host process; On/Off is start/stop
analogs.note: One Mac. LaunchAgent is the reboot policy. Not a fleet.

analogs.discord: channel realm = named checkout tag on the shared host
analogs.note: A realm is not an AWS account or VPC. Prompt-named repo still overrides cwd.

analogs.discord: JobPool max_live=8 plus per-cwd write lock
analogs.note: Listen and HOST Ask resolve cwd via realm_for_channel. Swarm implement also takes the write lock. Cap 8 is concurrent runners, not a blocked listen loop.

analogs.discord: REST drain + listen_watermarks snowflake cursor
analogs.note: Claim inbound before advancing the watermark, then submit. A crash after claim but before watermark retries as a duplicate skip, not a lost ask.

analogs.discord: SQLite runs/events plus one live card
analogs.note: fail_stale_runs is not resume. 429 retry is one in-process re-dispatch. Do not import a Temporal cluster.

analogs.discord: attachment + caption; durable key is snowflake triple + sha256
analogs.note: CDN URL is ephemeral (~24h). get() re-fetches the message for a fresh URL. Channel id is the ACL.

analogs.note: put_or_overflow already parks oversize locally. Discord message_snapshot is an immutable copy if we ever freeze a Done card.

analogs.discord: Discord CDN (not a durable key)
analogs.note: Jump links are for humans. Persisting a CDN URL as the object key is forbidden.

lifts.title: Durable intermediate artifacts, not chat as state
lifts.adapt: Each job already has DiscordObjectRef + SQLite events. Persist FINDING/plan/diff as typed artifacts with sha256 identity. Done answers should cite those snowflakes instead of re-inferring.

lifts.title: Execution lineage DAG for steer and retry
lifts.adapt: Encode kv = hash(step, inputs, parent hashes) in SQLite. A steer is an upstream edit; replay only descendants. Do not replace JobPool with a hosted orchestrator.

lifts.title: Durable job handle that survives host restart
lifts.adapt: Listen claims the Discord message, then watermarks, then submits. run_task skips a second claim when inbound_claimed is set.

lifts.title: Suspend for approval without a second UI
lifts.adapt: HOST Gate already parks implement. Restate-style suspend maps to a card button (existing Approve/Cancel/Retry) plus a SQLite wait state. Do not pay wall-clock on a hosted worker.

lifts.title: Keep Components v2 as the console, not Activities
lifts.adapt: Live cards already PATCH with IS_COMPONENTS_V2. Do not mix content+polls on those messages. Polls can later be Gate/Approve, never job status spam.

lifts.title: Message snapshots as immutable Glacier
lifts.adapt: Forward a Done card into a memory channel to freeze it. Snapshots do not follow later edits. Complements persist-then-settle.

lifts.title: Forum tags as ticket types, not a second job system
lifts.adapt: Jobs already open a thread on the user message. Forum channels would duplicate JobPool. Categories may later group realms visually.

lifts.title: Honor analyze vs implement on the Cursor CLI backend
lifts.adapt: PuppetmasterCliBackend.cursor_write_argv omits --implement on analyze. Agentic already used --mode.

lifts.title: REST-poll live job threads so steer is real
lifts.adapt: The listen loop unions live JobPool/orchestrator thread ids onto REST dests. FakeDiscord treats a thread id as a channel. Gateway stays buttons-only.

lifts.title: Serialize implement on resolved checkout, not channel id
lifts.adapt: Listen and HOST Ask pass resolved_write_key(intake, orch). Swarm takes the same write lock as implement.
